title: Private Retrieval Augmented Generation via Random Projection
abstract: arXiv:2610.22297v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) by querying external structured knowledge. However, it can also introduce privacy risks by leaking sensitive information from the retrieval datastore. We propose a simple method to preserve datastore privacy in RAG systems via random projection. By applying the same projection to both datastore embeddings and query embeddings, our method provably preserves semantic similarity between queries and retrieved items while substantially mitigating data extraction attacks. Across multiple RAG architectures and datasets, we show that this lightweight approach achieves superior retrieval and generation performance compared to prior methods which leverage formal differential privacy (DP) guarantees, while exhibiting comparable empirical privacy under strong attack models. translated_title: 基于随机投影的隐私保护检索增强生成
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过查询外部结构化知识来增强大语言模型（LLM）的能力。然而，它也可能因泄露检索数据存储中的敏感信息而引入隐私风险。我们提出了一种通过随机投影来保护RAG系统数据存储隐私的简单方法。通过对数据存储嵌入和查询嵌入应用相同的投影，我们的方法可以证明地保留查询与检索项之间的语义相似性，同时显著缓解数据提取攻击。在多种RAG架构和数据集上，我们展示了这种轻量级方法相比利用正式差分隐私（DP）保证的先前方法，实现了更优的检索和生成性能，同时在强攻击模型下表现出相当的实证隐私保护效果。我们的结果首次表明，随机投影可以作为一种有竞争力的隐私保护替代方案。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机投影的轻量级隐私保护方法，通过对数据存储嵌入和查询嵌入应用相同投影，在保留语义相似性的同时有效防御数据提取攻击，其检索和生成性能优于差分隐私方法且实证隐私保护效果相当。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight privacy-preserving method based on random projection, which applies the same projection to datastore and query embeddings to preserve semantic similarity while mitigating data extraction attacks, achieving superior retrieval and generation performance over differential privacy methods with comparable empirical privacy.
